title: Design an Ephemeral Streaming AI Chat App
prompt: Design an AI chat application where messages exist only in a tab's JavaScript memory: refresh, tab close, and reopen reset the conversation. Authentication may persist separately. Cover a protected server-side model proxy, one active generation per tab, streaming/cancel/retry/disconnect behavior, quotas, and context limits without adding conversation storage.

response.placeholder: Honor the no-persistence rule, then explain how streaming can still be safe and cancellable.
response.reference_answer:
## Client contract
Keep messages and generation state only in the in-memory tab store; do not use localStorage, IndexedDB, session storage, or server conversation records. A refresh intentionally starts empty. Input is disabled or queued while one generation is active.

## Server boundary
The browser sends the current bounded context to an authenticated gateway. The gateway owns provider credentials, applies per-user quotas, validates size/content policy, and proxies SSE chunks with a request ID. Cancel reaches the upstream request; reconnect can retry from a fresh request but does not recover a lost local transcript.

## Failure and telemetry
Trim context in the client by explicit token policy, distinguish stream disconnect from model failure, and log redacted operational metadata rather than messages. Measure TTFT, completion/cancel rate, disconnects, rejected context size, and quota errors.

## Progressive Hints
1. Session authentication is not conversation persistence.
2. A cancel must reach the upstream producer.
3. Privacy rules constrain analytics too.
